full_prompt_en: The image is a square classical oil portrait of a young woman in a dark floral hat and deep green dress, set against a nearly black olive background. The background is broad and quiet, with a little warmer brown-green haze at the lower left but no distinct interior or landscape. The woman fills the central and right portions of the frame in a close bust-length view, her shoulders turned toward the right while her face looks back to the viewer. A large dark hat curves across the upper edge and shades the brown curls around her forehead. Along its top right sit clustered blossoms in muted orange, pink, cream, and green, their soft colors becoming brighter against the dark brim. A long dark ribbon descends from the hat past her cheek and down over her shoulder. Her face is pale and softly rounded, with steady brown eyes, lightly colored cheeks, a slender nose, and closed rose lips forming a restrained smile. The face remains luminous but natural, modeled by warm gradual transitions rather than strong outlines. Around her neck, a cream lace collar folds in several delicate tiers, catching small warm highlights amid its shadowed creases. Beneath it, the rich deep green garment forms a broad diagonal shoulder shape that occupies the lower right and disappears into darkness at the edge. Fine folds in the fabric and narrow edging near the collar are visible without overtaking the face. Soft light enters from the upper left front, illuminating the forehead, cheeks, nose, lips, and lace while leaving the hat brim, ribbon, and far shoulder in deeper green-black shadow. The brushwork is smooth across the illuminated face, more textured in the lace and blossoms, and broad in the dark fabric and background. The close framing and dark surround make the slight turn of the shoulders and the calm direct gaze the center of attention. The overall composition balances a pale oval of light with deep green-black masses and small warm floral accents, creating a poised and intimate mood.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形古典油画肖像，一位年轻女子戴深色花饰帽、穿深绿衣裙，背景是近黑的橄榄色。背景宽阔而安静，左下略有暖棕绿色雾感，却没有明确的室内或风景。女子以近距离的胸像占据中央和右侧，肩膀朝右转，面孔则回望观者。一顶大而深色的帽子沿上边缘弯曲，遮住额前棕色卷发。帽子右上簇着低饱和橙色、粉色、奶油色与绿色花朵，柔软颜色在暗帽檐前显得更亮。一条长长的深色饰带从帽下经过脸颊，再垂到肩上。她的脸色浅而圆润，棕色眼睛安静注视，脸颊略带红晕，鼻子细长，合拢的玫瑰色嘴唇带克制的微笑。面孔明亮但自然，以温暖而渐进的明暗塑造，而非强硬轮廓。颈间的奶油色蕾丝领子折成几层细致褶边，细小暖色高光落在暗处的褶缝之间。其下浓深的绿色衣料形成占据右下方的宽大斜向肩形，到画边又融入黑暗。布面细褶与领口附近的窄饰边可见，却没有夺走面孔焦点。柔光从左前上方进入，照亮额头、脸颊、鼻子、嘴唇和蕾丝，帽檐、饰带和远侧肩膀则落在更深的绿黑阴影里。受光脸部的笔触平顺，蕾丝与花朵的笔触更有纹理，暗色衣料和背景则以宽笔带过。近距离构图与暗背景让肩膀的轻微转向和安静直视成为注意中心。整体构图以浅色的椭圆亮面平衡深绿黑色块，再用细小暖色花饰点缀，呈现端庄亲近的气氛。
style_prompt_en: Classical oil painting places a softly modeled luminous area inside broad, quiet dark color masses. Warm ivory, pale rose, and small amber accents emerge from deep olive, brown, and green-black, giving the brightest region a gentle concentration. Transitions across rounded volume are smooth and gradual, while fine ornamental passages retain more visible, delicate brush texture. Dark edges merge into the surrounding ground; illuminated edges become distinct without looking cut out. A single soft upper-side light makes the nearest planes glow and lets the rest fall into warm, colored shadow. The composition is close and asymmetrical, with a large curved dark area framing the compact zone of light. The overall treatment is refined, intimate, and restrained, relying on subtle tonal control rather than sharp contrast everywhere.
style_prompt_zh: 古典油画把一处柔和塑形的明亮区域置于宽阔安静的深色块中。暖象牙白、浅玫瑰色与细小琥珀色强调从深橄榄、棕色和绿黑色里浮出，让最亮区域温柔地集中。圆润体积上的转折平顺渐进，细致装饰段落则保留更多可见而精巧的笔触肌理。暗部边缘并入周围底色，受光边缘明确却没有剪纸感。单一柔和的上侧光让近处平面发亮，其余则落入带暖色的有色阴影。构图亲近且不对称，大块弯曲暗色围住紧凑亮区。整体处理精细、亲密而克制，依靠微妙明度控制，而非处处使用尖锐反差。
theme_en: A young woman in a dark floral hat and green dress against a shadowed background
theme_zh: 一位戴深色花饰帽、穿绿衣的年轻女子立于暗色背景前
name: Elisabeth Vigee Le Brun
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
